title: GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well above the human baseline in image geolocalization, a task critically important in disaster response, OSINT verification, and location privacy. However, most efforts to study AI behavior on the task remain limited to static image-based retrieval, classification, and predictions. We argue that faithful recreation of the task should involve embodied navigation, where a multimodal agent autonomously explores its surroundings to gather observations before submitting a prediction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{GeoAgent}, an agentic environment-based benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View environments to refine their geolocalization through sequential reasoning. Our analysis shows that modern VLMs struggle to discern regional patterns while succeeding at country- and continent-level predictions. translated_title: GeoAgent：通过具身导航评估视觉语言模型的地理定位能力
translated_abstract: 现代视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像地理定位任务上的表现远超人类基线，该任务在灾害响应、开源情报（OSINT）验证和位置隐私等方面至关重要。然而，大多数研究AI在该任务上行为的工作仍局限于基于静态图像的检索、分类和预测。我们认为，对该任务的忠实重现应当涉及具身导航，即由多模态智能体自主探索周围环境以收集观测信息，然后再提交预测。为此，我们提出了GeoAgent，一个基于环境的智能体基准，要求智能体在街景环境中进行导航，并通过序列推理来改进其地理定位结果。我们的分析表明，现代VLM难以辨别区域级别的模式，但在国家和大洲级别的预测上表现良好。与基于静态图像的基线相比，智能体导航显著……
tldr: 该论文提出了GeoAgent——一个要求智能体在街景环境中自主导航并通过序列推理完成地理定位的智能体基准，揭示了现代VLM虽然能完成国家和大洲级预测，却难以辨别区域级模式。
en_tdlr: GeoAgent introduces an environment-based agentic benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View scenes and refine geolocalization through sequential reasoning, revealing that modern VLMs succeed at country- and continent-level predictions but struggle to discern regional patterns.
